part_4_rulings.series_outcome: the v2.2 rehearsal series succeeded at ordinal 2 and that success stands, proven by digest chain and by the reviewer's contemporaneous verification. What is lost is the evidence bytes, not the fact.
part_4_rulings.bundle_recovery: impossible. Epoch-5's sealed-bundle recovery rehydrates the bundle from the sealed run archives; without the bytes there is nothing to rehydrate and nothing may be reconstructed from digests or reports. The epoch-5 r3 candidate, its review and the pending gate are stood down; the candidate is not landed.
part_4_rulings.release_path: the registered release requires a validator-checked bundle. The honest path is a new rehearsal series under a preregistration amendment that records this loss, not a relaxation of the release gate.
part_4_rulings.operator_standing_down: no gate, landing, preflight, recovery authorization or cleanup proceeds; all surviving evidence directories are preserved as-is

part_5_finding_W7.title: Immutable evidence lived in hidden folders inside a directory the owner cleans by hand
part_5_finding_W7.rule: durable evidence must live in a visible, unmistakably named location outside any directory used for disk cleanup, and every sealed attempt must be copied at seal time to a second location the owner designates; a ledger with one copy on a laptop is not durable
